# Routing by the document's language (ARCHITECTURE.md §7.2): the declared language
# decides the runs of its own script; the other script keeps the default routing.

# No language: Latin is English, Arabic script is Arabic.
A ⟦mistaek⟧ and ⟦كتابب⟧.

@lang en-US
The color was gray, and the ⟦colour⟧ is ⟦grey⟧. Arabic is still checked: ⟦كتابب⟧.

@lang en-GB
The colour was grey, and the ⟦color⟧ is ⟦gray⟧.

@lang ar
⟦كتابب⟧ and a ⟦mistaek⟧.

# Persian or Urdu: Arabic-script runs have no dictionary and are left alone.
@lang fa
این یک متن فارسی است و کتابب. English is still checked: ⟦mistaek⟧.
@lang ur
یہ اردو ہے۔ And a ⟦mistaek⟧.

# German or Swedish: Latin runs aren't English and are left alone.
@lang de
Das ist ein deutscher Satz mit Fehlre, und ⟦كتابب⟧ wird geprüft.
@lang sv-SE
Det här är en svensk mening.

# A malformed tag keeps the default routing.
@lang not-a-language-tag!
A ⟦mistaek⟧ and ⟦كتابب⟧.
@lang
